title: The Perceptron: A Probabilistic Model for Information Storage and Organization in the Brain
summary: The seminal paper introducing the Perceptron, laying mathematical foundations for modern neural networks through probabilistic modeling.

title: A New Approach to Linear Filtering and Prediction Problems
summary: Landmark introduction of the Kalman Filter providing recursive solutions to linear filtering problems using state-space methods.

title: Learning Representations by Back-propagating Errors
summary: Establishment of backpropagation as the fundamental method for training multi-layer neural networks via gradient descent.

title: Estimation of Probabilities from Sparse Data for the Language Model Component of a Speech Recognizer
venue: IEEE Transactions on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing
summary: Development of Turing discounting for probability redistribution of unseen n-grams in language modeling.

title: A Theoretical Framework for Back-Propagation
summary: Theoretical formalization of backpropagation using Lagrangian analysis from optimal control theory.

title: Optimal Brain Damage
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
summary: Parameter pruning via second-order derivative analysis to reduce network complexity without sacrificing performance.

title: Learning Long-Term Dependencies with Gradient Descent is Difficult
summary: Formalization of the vanishing gradient problem in recurrent networks with proposed solution approaches.

title: Support-Vector Networks
summary: Introduction of support vector machines enabling non-linear classification through kernel methods.

title: Bidirectional Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: Enhancement of RNNs by processing sequences in both directions for improved context understanding.

title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
summary: Introduction of Word2Vec algorithms (Skip-gram and CBOW) for efficient word embedding learning.

title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
summary: Breakthrough demonstration of deep CNN power on large-scale image classification using GPUs.

title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
venue: Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
summary: Introduction of attention mechanism enabling models to focus on relevant input parts for translation.

title: Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
summary: Foundational work on sequence-to-sequence models using LSTMs for machine translation and beyond.

title: Neural GPUs Learn Algorithms
summary: Demonstration of neural networks learning algorithmic tasks with generalization beyond training sequences.

title: Attention Is All You Need
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
summary: Introduction of the Transformer architecture based purely on attention mechanisms, enabling efficient parallelization.

title: Greedy Layer-Wise Training of Deep Networks
summary: Layer-wise pre-training approach for deep networks enabling better weight initialization and convergence.

title: Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks
summary: Deep autoencoders as powerful alternative to PCA for nonlinear dimensionality reduction.

title: Curriculum Learning
summary: Strategy of training neural networks by progressively increasing task difficulty for improved convergence.
